cells.gaps: No programme teaching the public digital skills has been found in service; the strategy's digital literacy programmes are to start in 2027. No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found.
cells.note: The approved Seychelles Digital and AI Strategy includes digital literacy programmes, with first initiatives expected in 2027 and early 2028, a programme in preparation, so stage 2. None is reported in service with a count of people trained, so not stage 3.
